title: Service selector matches no pods
report: Calls to the checkout service fail with connection refused, yet the checkout pods look healthy.

also_accept.why: the selector is part of the Service spec; the ruleset glosses service_misconfig as 'ports or other service spec wrong'

example.root_cause: Service checkout selects app=checkout-v2 but its pods are labelled app=checkout, so it has no endpoints
example.fix: change the checkout Service selector to app: checkout
